description: Delete an email (disabled by default, requires explicit configuration). On Gmail only drafts can be deleted under the default scopes, and a draft delete is permanent (Gmail has no trash for drafts); deleting sent or received Gmail mail returns NOT_SUPPORTED.

id.description: Message id to delete. On Gmail this must be a draft: either its draft id or the id of its message. A Gmail draft gets a new message id on every update; its draft id stays stable.

name: delete_email
